北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感 13℃。昼夜温差大，早晚注意添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Beijing, feels like 13℃. Mind the temperature difference and dress warmly, especially mornings and evenings!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，气温 25℃。出门带伞，祝您一天好心情！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast with 25℃. Bring an umbrella, have a lovely day!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，气温 24℃。体感舒适，记得保持好心情哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast with 24℃. Enjoy the comfortable weather and stay cheerful!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，湿度 84%。潮湿，注意除湿，保持好心情！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast with 84% humidity. It's damp, remember to dehumidify and stay cheerful!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳中雨，气温 23℃。雨天路滑，外出请带好雨具！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen has moderate rain at 23℃. Roads are slippery, remember your umbrella!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天 26℃，体感 22℃。温差较大，出门穿衣要注意哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast with 26℃, feels like 22℃. Mind the temperature difference when dressing!
杭州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴天 28℃，体感 24℃。阳光正好，出门记得防晒哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny with 28℃, feels like 24℃. Enjoy the sunshine, remember your sunscreen!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天 26℃。体感舒适，出门带把伞以防万一哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with 26℃. Comfortable, but bring an umbrella just in case!
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，气温 23℃。体感舒适，祝您有个愉快的周末！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast with 23℃. Comfortable weather, wishing you a pleasant day!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天 28℃，湿度 12%。空气干燥，记得多喝水滋润哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast with 28℃, 12% humidity. Air is dry, remember to hydrate!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，湿度 61%。体感舒适，出门记得带好雨具哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast with 61% humidity. Comfortable, but remember your rain gear!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天，体感 -5℃。非常寒冷，请务必多穿衣保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is overcast, feels like -5℃. It's freezing, please dress very warmly!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳大雨，体感 3℃。风雨交加，出行务必注意安全保暖！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has heavy rain, feels like 3℃. It's windy and rainy, stay safe and warm!
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天 25℃，风力 4 级。风有点大，注意防风保暖哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast with 25℃, wind force 4. It's windy, mind the wind and stay warm!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天 23℃。湿度 69%，出门记得带好雨具哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast with 23℃, 69% humidity. Remember to bring your rain gear!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云 16℃。体感舒适，早晚记得添衣哦，别着凉了！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy with 16℃. Comfortable, but add layers in the morning/evening to avoid colds!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云 16℃，体感 9℃。气温偏低，外出请务必多穿衣！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy with 16℃, feels like 9℃. It's chilly, please dress very warmly!
